off_identity.description: Every Phase 4.2 switch explicitly off: zero paired differences (retrieval and refusal) against the committed baseline of each fixture mode, and against the Phase 4.1 default run config on the same data

diversity.description: duplicate_flood: intent coverage 1.0 on the slice, every item's topk_redundancy at most 1/k (k = the item's context_k), no other slice drops beyond the noise band against the Phase 4.1 default run

identifier.description: identifier_near_miss plus the no_answer items tagged asked_identifier (asked identifier absent): identifier precision 1.0 and near-miss leakage 0.0 measured on every one of those items; the descriptive slice and every other slice within the noise band against the Phase 4.1 default run

descriptive.definition: gated items whose trace in the identifier run has an identifier block with zero asked identifiers (pipeline's own extraction); compared on the same item ids in the reference run

table.description: Every item tagged feature:table_lookup keeps a chunk for every gold unit and its gold candidate carries the table:0 list in its fused ranks; no slice drops

versions.description: Every item tagged feature:versions hits every evidence group; its superseded kept chunks carry is_current false and a document_version (at least one superseded chunk kept); in the reference run those items keep no superseded chunk; no slice drops

dictionary.description: Lexical dictionary on: no slice drops beyond the noise band against the Phase 4.1 default run

stem_it.description: flip only when the language:it Recall@10 gain over the reference exceeds the noise band (max(k * spread, floor) of the reference) and no slice drops beyond the band; otherwise keep_off

refusal_mode_cells.description: commit the per-mode fixture cells only when every mode cell is calibrated on dev (fit_status fitted, threshold set), passes its holdout check (status calibrated), and every strict cell's threshold is not below its base cell's; otherwise keep. Base cells whose shared and mode cells all have insufficient_data are skipped: no cell of that base would be committed

report_only.note: reported per run by cache state, never gated (D-26)
